alpaca.note: First US daily-price source since Day 129 (free plan, 200 calls a minute, adjusted bars). Measured 2026-11-21: closes within 0.04% of Twelve Data and Yahoo over the whole 2y history on AAPL, JNJ, NEE, NVDL, QPUX; no split error on NVDL or QPUX; volume x0.85-1.01 of Twelve Data. Bars with zero volume are not emitted, so thin funds can miss sessions.

alphavantage.note: Fundamentals growth in the chain. Toronto prices work as .TRT. 25 calls a day, 1 a second.

eodhd.note: Not in the chain. Free key: 20 calls a day, 1 year of history. SOXL.NEO is still close-only.

finnhub.note: Fundamentals core fields. Not tested for prices or Canada.

fmp.note: Canadian symbols return HTTP 402 on the free key.

tradier.note: Fast and clean for US names, but a 1:3 reverse split is applied wrongly (QPUX before 2026-03-20 is 3x too high). Not dividend-adjusted. Needs BRK/B for Berkshire.

twelvedata.note: Free plan has no Canadian symbols (Grow plan needed). Rate limited: 8 a minute, about 800 a day.

yfinance.note: Only source for Canada. Toronto (.TO) is accurate, including the CDRs. Cboe Canada (.NE): SOXL.NE is close-only with an unadjusted 3:1 split; other .NE names are thin: use .TO.

indicators.formula: Average of the last 50 (or 200) closes. Completed days only: today's unfinished bar is left out (Day 126).
indicators.name: SMA 50 / 200

indicators.formula: Starts at the first close, then EMA = close x k + previous EMA x (1 - k), k = 2/(period+1), run over every completed bar. Today's unfinished bar is left out (Day 126).
indicators.name: EMA 8 / 21

indicators.formula: Wilder: first average = simple mean of 14 moves, then (previous x 13 + today) / 14. Decides the verdict's Strong / Decent band. Completed days only (Day 126). A flat price history gives 100.
indicators.name: RSI 14

indicators.formula: Wilder: first average = mean of the first 14 true ranges (the first bar counts as high minus low), then (previous x 13 + today) / 14, over the whole history. Sets the Trade Setup stop (2 x ATR). Uses finished days only; today's unfinished bar is left out.
indicators.name: ATR 14
indicators.source: this stock's daily high, low, close

indicators.formula: Wilder smoothing (pandas ewm, alpha 1/14) of +DM, -DM and true range; ADX is the smoothed DX. Completed days only (Day 126).
indicators.name: ADX 14
indicators.source: this stock's daily high, low, close

indicators.formula: Average of the last 50 daily volumes; RVOL = the day's volume / that average. The Technical Read uses the last COMPLETED session while today is still forming; the raw API value for today's unfinished bar reads low mid-session.
indicators.name: Avg volume 50 / RVOL

indicators.formula: (stock today / stock 251 bars ago) / (SPY today / SPY 251 bars ago): a ratio of growth factors. With 201-251 bars it uses the oldest bar, so its "52 weeks" is shorter; under 201 bars there is no RS.
indicators.name: RS 52W

indicators.formula: Not calculated from prices. Taken from the provider; Yahoo computes P/E / (EPS growth x 100) when it is missing. The Value tab switches to PEGY (growth + dividend yield) locally when the yield is over 1.5%.
indicators.name: PEG
indicators.source: a data provider (Finnhub, then Alpha Vantage, then Yahoo)

freshness.note: last bar 2026-11-26, 1 session behind (a market holiday can explain 1-2)

integrity.note: 0% of bars flat with zero volume; 0 malformed bars; zero volume on 0 of the last 5 days
